cases.reason: Neither draft passes every mandatory claim, so there is no eligible winner. A says “At that point, the packaged skill had not been prospectively validated for reliable detector performance.” B says “As of that evidence, the packaged skill had not yet been prospectively validated for reliable detector performance.” Both narrow AX15 to historical non-validation while the contract requires the current packaged skill’s non-validation. B’s “What the dated development examples show” improves the transition from use instructions to dated evidence, but reader flow cannot override the shared required-claim omission. This tie records no eligible selection, not equal passing quality.
